scene: Black Pool, a high rocky mountain bowl with pine trees and thick drifting mist around a small dark lake that is almost dry with cracked mud shores, three small children Mei, Tao and Hua stand together at the lower left shore looking up, a big grey boulder at the right, a huge empty area of soft swirling white mist and pale sky above the boulder in the centre and right, no houses, no dragon, wide shot
